title: feat(plugin-detail): fold a kept all-empty record section, and an all-empty body (objectui#13386)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D3jMyxwR7kHLu9j9TjYFimf)_

Fixes #13386
Fixes #12618

Seat: domain:ui#4 · card thread `session_01AqaieDWuDnBRyh3u8epGx6` · claim 6391455338
Ruling-ref: 6369306878 (batch #7 item 4, letter C)
Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: semantic (the spec side landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#25612)

## What changes

Ruling C: in read-only mode an all-empty section that the page keeps draws its heading plus ONE "Show N empty fields" row, the same toggle a partly-filled section uses, instead of one em-dash row per field. Edit mode is unchanged, and a body whose sections are all empty folds once more (item 2 of #12618).

| Where | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `DetailSection`, all-empty section kept (`hideEmpty: false`, or omitted where no default resolves it), read-only | heading + one `No value` row per field | heading + one "Show N empty fields" row; the toggle reveals the rows and "Hide empty fields" folds them back |
| same, edit mode | every field an editable row | unchanged |
| same, print page | every row prints | unchanged: every row prints, no toggle (#12717) |
| `hideEmpty: true` all-empty section | renders nothing | unchanged |
| partly-filled section | heuristic fold (#7129 Q2-C) | unchanged |
| detail body (`DetailView` sections) where every section is empty and at least two are kept | one folded section after another | ONE "Show N empty fields" row for the body (new `EmptySectionsFold`); revealing it draws each section folded on its own |

No key, shape or default moved, and no new i18n key: both rows reuse `detail.showEmptyFields` / `detail.hideEmptyFields`. The `hideEmpty` descriptions in `@object-ui/types` (`DetailViewSection`, `RecordDetailsSection`, the zod mirror) and the two `@object-ui/plugin-detail` registration texts now say what a kept section draws.

## Readings taken (for the seat's review)

1. **"Kept" includes an omitted key where no default resolves it.** The ruling names `hideEmpty: false`. On `detail-view`, the `detail-section` node and the `record:details` direct-`fields` fallback, omitted already meant the same as `false` (keep), and their descriptions said so. The fold keeps them equal, so the test is "kept" (`!hideAllEmptySection`), not `=== false`. On `record:details` authored sections nothing changes for an omitted key: it still resolves `?? true` and hides.
2. **Copy.** The ruling's 「N 个空字段 · 展开」 is described as "the same fold the mixed sections use", so the row is that fold's existing copy: `Show 4 empty fields` (en), `显示 4 个空字段` (zh). No new string.
3. **Body fold threshold.** The body folds only when every section that draws anything is all-empty AND at least two are kept: one kept section is already one row, so folding it again would only drop its heading. Section groups (`sectionGroups`) turn the body fold off, as they draw fields of their own beside the sections. A malformed section (no field array, or a read that throws) turns it off too, so each section still renders or fails inside its own boundary (#8497).

## Tests

- New: `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.allEmptyFold-13386.test.tsx` — the 「交易说明」 fixture: heading + one "Show 4 empty fields" row and no em-dash; reveal and fold back; untitled section; `hideEmpty: true` control; edit mode draws four textboxes and no fold; print page prints four rows; mixed sections (small and large) unchanged; body fold counts 8 over three sections, reveals each section folded, folds back; controls for a filled field anywhere, a single kept section, edit mode and print page; `emptySectionsFoldCount` rules including malformed sections.
- Reverse check: with `DetailSection.tsx` at base, 6 of the new file's cases go red (the edit-mode, print, mixed and count cases stay green, as they pin unchanged behaviour).
- Updated pins that read an all-empty kept section's rows, now through the fold: `record-details.hideEmptyRetired-7129` 4/4(b), `record-details.emptySectionDefault` (`false` keeps; direct-`fields` fallback), `detailSectionAuthoredHideEmpty-10485`, the AMPLIFICATION cases of `DetailSection.emptyArray-8474` and `DetailSection.emptinessAuthority-8376` (now: the fold counts all four rows, so the empty value is not counted as filled), `inlineCredentialGate` (`signature`'s empty sample reveals the fold before reading the pencil), `record-details.unresolvedIdentityFailClosed-9054` (the legacy `fieldName` entry survives as "Show 1 empty field").
